title: In FIRSTNONBLANK an aggregate that is not a measure is not filtered by the current value

source.quote: Returns the first value in the column for which the expression has a non blank value.
source.supports: the first value, in the order of the column values, whose expression is not blank

source.quote: By using the SUMX expression, the context transition does not happen because the implicit CALCULATE around the measure reference is missing.
source.supports: an aggregation written out, unlike a measure reference, has no context transition inside an iteration

derivation: The expression is evaluated in a row context for each country. SUM ( Sales[Amount] ) is not a measure reference and has no CALCULATE, so the row context does not filter it: it is 540 for every country, FR included. The first country in order is FR.
alternative: The quoted rule is stated for expressions in iterators in general, not for FIRSTNONBLANK. If FIRSTNONBLANK filtered the aggregate by the current value, as it does for a measure, FR would be BLANK and the result would be JP.
